rules: QR points to permanent Academy lesson route after authenticated access check, never video storage endpoint.
M4Y and BH are separate families. BH has 2 current Udemy source videos.
No automatic book QR for On The Edge, Line of Fire, blades, firearms, stick or Materyal.
No QR is print-ready; source candidates need frame and instructor verification.
B03-G03 Kida is the greeting in the author's original manuscript (p. 10); one card and one verified Academy lesson QR unless a distinct lesson warrants a separate editorial decision.
Book QR access is limited to lessons explicitly published in the Krav Maga Kitap Görsel Eğitim curriculum; membership alone does not grant access to all Academy modules.
Academy course access is assigned through the administrator panel to Krav Maga members; a book entitlement is scoped to the book visual curriculum and must be checked server-side after sign-in.

Tam iki ayak görünür; 125 mm prova genişliğinde yaklaşık 303 ppi. B09 düşme kaynağı değildir. 2026-10-01 new-chat SUP visual audit: 00:02 open stance and 00:06 forward-step source frames compared with the two-panel 3D proof. Pose distinction is clear, but Basic/Duruslar.wmv identity and named stance mapping remain unverified. Keep sourceVerified=false and printReady=false. 2026-10-01 SUP B06 source audit: source manuscript explicitly names three stance categories: Pasif defense, Semi Defense, and Savaşçı duruşu. Current WhatsApp source video only supports two observed poses (00:02 open stance, 00:06 forward-step) and does not by itself establish the full named three-stance set or their exact labels. Keep sourceVerified=false and printReady=false until named stance-to-pose mapping is sourced.
